name: Florida Metal Craft Inc
old_description: Since our founding in 1931, we’ve worked with tens of thousands of clients around the globe with a focus on our local residents and businesses. Our outstanding service and professionalism started from humble beginnings and has grown to a 4th generation family-owned business spanning 92 years. We pride ourselves on being large enough to get the job done, but small enough to form a lasting connection. The length we go to keep our customers satisfied speaks greatly to the commitment and resolve of our owners and staff.
about:
Florida Metal Craft Inc has operated from Winter Garden, Florida, since its founding in 1931. Now in its fourth generation of family ownership, the company began as a modest metalworking shop and has grown over nine decades into a business that serves tens of thousands of clients worldwide while maintaining a focus on local residents and businesses.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, including ornamental scrolling work, repair, and painting services. Testimonials highlight quick turnaround on projects such as mailbox restoration, where a bent and broken piece was fixed and painted within hours. The company describes itself as large enough to handle substantial jobs yet small enough to maintain personal connections with customers.

Customers range from individual homeowners needing decorative metal repairs to commercial and industrial clients seeking fabrication services. The company's global client base includes businesses and residents across multiple countries, though specific industries are not detailed in available materials.

Florida Metal Craft emphasizes outstanding service and professionalism as its defining traits, rooted in the commitment and resolve of its owners and staff. The balance of capacity and personal attention is presented as the core reason customers return.
